name: south_indian_scroll_reveal
description: Vertical 9:16 announcement: couple greet, hug, lift and twirl, pull a rope, a scroll unrolls to reveal the real wedding card, confetti, final namaste. The card is composited from your own image so its text is never distorted.

variables.setting: Warm dark-maroon festive backdrop with golden bokeh, glowing diyas and marigold garlands at the corners, soft cinematic golden light.

style: Vertical 9:16 Pixar-style 3D animated video, smooth 24fps cinematic motion, expressive but natural body language.

characters.groom: Slim athletic young man. Face, curly black hair, moustache and short beard EXACTLY as in the reference photos, red bindi. Maroon-gold embroidered kurta, cream dhoti, rose garland.
characters.bride: Slim young woman. Face, smile, hair and forehead jewellery EXACTLY as in the reference photos, red bindi. Orange and purple silk saree, gold jewellery, red bangles, rose garland.

rules: Strict identity lock on both faces, no face morphing, natural slim body proportions (no belly, no oversized head or body), no extra people, no on-screen text, no watermark, no logos.
negative_prompt: overweight, chubby, big belly, distorted face, face morphing, extra fingers, extra people, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality

scenes.title: Greeting, hug, lift and twirl
scenes.action: 0-1.5s both stand side by side smiling and greet with namaste. 1.5-3s they share a warm hug. 3-4.5s the groom lifts the bride by the waist and spins her smoothly. 4.5-6s the bride lands and twirls gracefully while the groom claps with joy.

scenes.title: Rope pull and scroll reveal
scenes.action: 0-1.5s the bride waves at the camera, then skips to a golden-tasselled rope hanging on the right. 1.5-2.5s she pulls the rope firmly while the groom watches excitedly. 2.5-8s a plain blank cream scroll unrolls from a wooden rod at the top centre of the frame (leave it blank, no writing). Slow steady camera push-in while the couple stand happily beside it.

scenes.title: Confetti burst and final namaste
scenes.action: 0-2s both jump with joy as a golden confetti and rose-petal burst fires around the hanging scroll. 2-4s both wave cheerfully at the camera. 4-6s final wide shot, both join palms in a warm namaste, smiling.
